SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_display, a.mobile, a.email, a.status, a.last_login_time, a.created_time, a.person_id, p.person_code, p.person_name, o.org_code, o.org_name, pos.post_code, pos.post_name, creator.account_display as created_name FROM exp_account a LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON a.person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit o ON a.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post pos ON a.post_id = pos.post_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON a.created_by = creator.account_id
AND a.account_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%')
AND p.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personName}, '%')
AND p.person_code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personCode}, '%')
AND a.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mobile}, '%')
ORDER BY a.created_time DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM exp_account a LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON a.person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit o ON a.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post pos ON a.post_id = pos.post_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON a.created_by = creator.account_id
AND a.account_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{accountName}, '%')
AND p.person_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{personName}, '%')
AND a.mobile LIKE CONCAT('%', #{mobile}, '%')

SELECT a.account_id, a.account_name, a.account_display, a.mobile, a.email, a.person_id, p.person_code, p.person_name, a.org_id, o.org_code, o.org_name, a.post_id, pos.post_code, pos.post_name, a.status, a.login_fail_count, a.last_login_time, a.last_login_ip, a.pwd_last_change_time, a.need_change_pwd, a.created_by, creator.account_display as created_name, a.created_time, a.updated_time, a.remark FROM exp_account a LEFT JOIN exp_person p ON a.person_id = p.person_id LEFT JOIN exp_org_unit o ON a.org_id = o.org_id LEFT JOIN exp_post pos ON a.post_id = pos.post_id LEFT JOIN exp_account creator ON a.created_by = creator.account_id WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId}

SELECT #{accountId} as accountId, r.role_id as roleId, r.role_name as roleName, r.role_code as roleCode FROM exp_role r INNER JOIN exp_role_assign ra ON r.role_id = ra.role_id INNER JOIN exp_account a ON ( (ra.principal_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND ra.principal_id = a.account_id) OR (ra.principal_type = 'PERSON' AND ra.principal_id = a.person_id AND a.person_id IS NOT NULL) OR (ra.principal_type = 'POST' AND ra.principal_id = a.post_id AND a.post_id IS NOT NULL) OR (ra.principal_type = 'ORG' AND ra.principal_id = a.org_id AND a.org_id IS NOT NULL) ) WHERE a.account_id = #{accountId} AND ra.status = 'ENABLED' AND r.status = 'ENABLED' AND (ra.start_time IS NULL OR ra.start_time <= NOW()) AND (ra.end_time IS NULL OR ra.end_time >= NOW()) GROUP BY r.role_id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.sort_no ORDER BY r.sort_no

SELECT DISTINCT account_id FROM ( SELECT ra.principal_id AS account_id FROM exp_role_assign ra WHERE ra.role_id = #{roleId} AND ra.principal_type = 'ACCOUNT' AND ra.status = 'ENABLED' AND (ra.start_time IS NULL OR ra.start_time <= NOW()) AND (ra.end_time IS NULL OR ra.end_time >= NOW()) UNION SELECT a.account_id FROM exp_account a INNER JOIN exp_role_assign ra ON ra.principal_id = a.person_id AND ra.principal_type = 'PERSON' WHERE ra.role_id = #{roleId} AND a.person_id IS NOT NULL AND ra.status = 'ENABLED' AND (ra.start_time IS NULL OR ra.start_time <= NOW()) AND (ra.end_time IS NULL OR ra.end_time >= NOW()) UNION SELECT a.account_id FROM exp_account a INNER JOIN exp_role_assign ra ON ra.principal_id = a.post_id AND ra.principal_type = 'POST' WHERE ra.role_id = #{roleId} AND a.post_id IS NOT NULL AND ra.status = 'ENABLED' AND (ra.start_time IS NULL OR ra.start_time <= NOW()) AND (ra.end_time IS NULL OR ra.end_time >= NOW()) UNION SELECT a.account_id FROM exp_account a INNER JOIN exp_role_assign ra ON ra.principal_id = a.org_id AND ra.principal_type = 'ORG' WHERE ra.role_id = #{roleId} AND a.org_id IS NOT NULL AND ra.status = 'ENABLED' AND (ra.start_time IS NULL OR ra.start_time <= NOW()) AND (ra.end_time IS NULL OR ra.end_time >= NOW()) ) t
